verzen.tekst: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked:
verzen.html: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked:

verzen.tekst: For he flatters himself in his own eyes,
verzen.html: For he flatters himself in his own eyes,

verzen.tekst: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit.
verzen.html: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit.

verzen.tekst: He plots iniquity on his bed.
verzen.html: He plots iniquity on his bed.

verzen.tekst: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens.
verzen.html: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens.

verzen.tekst: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God.
verzen.html: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God.

verzen.tekst: How precious is your loving kindness, God!
verzen.html: How precious is your loving kindness, God!

verzen.tekst: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house.
verzen.html: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house.

verzen.tekst: For with you is the spring of life.
verzen.html: For with you is the spring of life.

verzen.tekst: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you,
verzen.html: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you,

verzen.tekst: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me.
verzen.html: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me.

verzen.tekst: There the workers of iniquity are fallen.
verzen.html: There the workers of iniquity are fallen.
